extraction_instructions: Courses: three category pages (/education/courses/virtual-courses/, /skills-courses/, /seminars/) hold card--basic links with a super-title date ('Nov. 5-7, 2026'), unioned by URL; fees sit on the same-site <course>/registration/ sub-page ('label' then '$2,599'). Annual Meeting: /annual/attend/future-meetings/ lists the next two meetings (city—year, date range, venue); registration/fees open months ahead so no tiers until then. USD.

WooCommerce shop (9 products per page, /shop/page/N/). Every course date is three products: a two-day 'DD/DD Month YYYY - Course' product (both days) plus a 'Day 1' and 'Day 2' single-day product. Grouped into ONE event per two-day product, with the day products as extra fee tiers; dates come from the title, times from the FooEvents 'Event Details' tab (first day). Past dates (2025) are listed and dropped. Venue is only stated for the cadaveric course (Queen Mary University, London, in the meta description).

No event cards: the hub page names the next CEU meeting in a sentence ('Clinical Endocrinology Update (CEU) 2026, taking place online October 22-24'), /endo-future-meetings lists ENDO 2027-2029 (title, date range, city) and /keystone-conference lists Endocrine Society x Keystone Symposia joint meetings as '(Feb 1-4, 2027 | Keystone, Colo.)' with links to keystonesymposia.org, whose /meeting/pricing/<CODE> page holds the USD fee grid. CEU lives on ceu2026.endocrine.org (EventScribe, Cloudflare 403): shell values only.

ASP.NET page with one server-rendered table (tr.type-symposium|longitudinal|ajr|annual): event name, year-less date for near-term rows or a full range for Annual Meetings, location, 'Learn more' link. Longitudinal course rows are sessions of two courses (rows sharing one link) and become one parent course with sessions. Symposium and course pages list fees as 'label / $amount' line pairs (In Training FREE/$0); Annual Meeting pages have no fees yet; AJR Live webinars show no fee. USD.

Craft CMS card list (li.card-three: heading, date line, category chips); only /events holds live events, /events/p2 and later are archive lists of undated 'last three years' pages and must not be walked. Some cards carry no date (online Basic/Advanced Colposcopy courses) and are dated from their detail page or dropped. Detail pages are free prose with fees/venue in text.

One flat page of event cards (title, tagline, date range, venue, city) with an external REGISTER / SAVE THE DATE link to each meeting's own site; no detail pages on crf.org. Cards go ~5 years out so only the next ~18 months are kept; the Pulse Gala is a fundraiser and skipped. Fees are read from the meeting site's registration page when it has a rate grid (USD).

Flat Elementor page of partner-congress cards (image link to the partner site, title, 'City, Country' and a date range), repeated in hidden responsive variants and including past years. Cards are complete shells; booking_url is the partner site. EADV's own Symposium and Congress come from /symposium/ and /congress/ page titles when upcoming; the UEMS exam card is skipped.

WooCommerce product grid, one product per dated course; date and group (ATACC Course vs ATACC Ireland) come from the product title, price from the grid, stock from the li class. Products are grouped into one course parent with sessions[]; venue, description and CPD come from /tag-training/atacc/.

Listing links to ~12 course pages; the listing shows no dates, so each course page is read and only courses with upcoming 'Location/Date' rows are kept. Course page: Upcoming Dates rows (city dd/mm/yyyy, availability FULL or N places, From price), duplicated for mobile/desktop. One parent per course with sessions[]; CPD points in the course bullets.
Single .aspx page with a bullet list of future meetings; each item links to a detail page and carries its date in the item text. Undated 'to be announced' items are skipped.
